legacy_root.definition: Closed set of transfers from named non-agent coordination protocols onto the WFA-0044 IR kind set. discriminating_examples: ADOPTED: receiver-synthesis gate (I-PASS S) vs sender-only typed handoff

evidence_backed_transfers.definition: Before any side-effecting tool call, the executing role must restated the constrained fields of the instruction (task id, tool allowlist, stopping expression) in the same order they were issued; the issuing role must confirm match. Silence is not confirmation.
evidence_backed_transfers.discriminating_example: Before any side-effecting tool call, the executing role must restated the constrained fields of the instruction (task id, tool allowlist, stopping expression) in the same order they were issued; the issuing role must confirm match. Silence is not confirmation.

falsification.remaining_mapping: Constrained field echo + originator confirm as a gate/barrier pair before tool_policy allows side effects.
falsification.source_property_that_does_not_hold: Shared voice radio, certified phraseology, and safety-of-life timing with a legally responsible controller.

mapping_table.source_role_or_step: pilot readback of numbers in issued order

evidence_backed_transfers.source_quote: Pilots of airborne aircraft should read back those parts of ATC clearances and instructions containing altitude assignments, vectors, or runway assignments as a means of mutual verification. The readback of the "numbers" serves as a double check between pilots and controllers and reduces the kinds of communications errors that occur when a number is either "misheard" or is incorrect.
evidence_backed_transfers.source_title: FAA Aeronautical Information Manual 4-4-7 Pilot Responsibility upon Clearance Issuance

legacy_root.question: Which coordination mechanisms from non-agent domains - distributed consensus, air-traffic and clinical handoff protocols, editorial peer review, jury instruction, incident command, Delphi forecasting - have a defensible mapping onto multi-agent workflow stages that no existing candidate implements?

speculative_transfers.definition: Cap fan_out at 3-7 subordinates per supervisor because that is the ICS numeric span-of-control band.
speculative_transfers.discriminating_example: Cap fan_out at 3-7 subordinates per supervisor because that is the ICS numeric span-of-control band.

falsification.remaining_mapping: A declared fan_out cap is IR-expressible, but the specific 3-7 band is not evidence-backed for agents.
falsification.source_property_that_does_not_hold: Human attention and radio-net congestion that make five live subordinates a safety limit. Software agents do not share that attention cost; the number 3-7 is not justified here.

speculative_transfers.source_quote: Unity of command means that each individual only reports to one person.
